chapter_title: The Apostle asks his Disciples: What is Cloud?

spiritual_reading.full_translation:
Know that disordered governing falsities, long held bound within a sufficient range of outermost states, will be loosened, and their operation will rise and spread through the whole natural degree; and this ascent will be made manifest within the intermediate region where inner and outer meet.

Then an obscuring state will be lifted by the arousal of perverted love toward higher perception, and it will be brought into the presence of manifested divine wisdom in the form of pure truth. The mark of it is sudden outward eruptions that attend conflicts of falsity, together with reciprocal disturbances within that state. By that divine wisdom whatever can be amended there is purified insofar as it can be turned toward the truth then disclosed; and the governing falsities that had ruled within it are loosened by those conflicts, driven out, and dispatched.

Yet protective powers are at once directed to restrain them, because their quality is known: they cannot will good. Wherever their influence touches, they induce spiritual death and loss. When the protective powers turn toward them and draw near, those falsities retreat under inner compulsion. They insinuate themselves into whatever disposition they encounter and take it on, as evil hides in a form while fleeing the stronger good that pursues to bring it under order.

Thus the governing falsities, once expelled from those obscuring states, enter into whatever they can seize in the outer life—into some structure of perception, or into affections, or into human states. Wherever they take possession, they consume and devastate by the ardor of their own craving; for they are powers of self-love, offspring of perverted love, deprived of heavenly love.

But an obscuring state arising from falsified understanding is also lifted and brought upward toward that same manifestation of divine wisdom. Its mark is the rumbling and recurring outbursts that are heard in the intermediate region in many variations. There are times when the governing falsities proper to that state are constrained within such falsified understanding; then they recoil from it and abandon it.

Even so, wherever they extend, they induce hardening and chilling in the outer life. They ruin interior truths in potency, and the works that would proceed from them, and the growing forms of spiritual life; they waste whatever region they reach.

Again protective powers are directed to restrain them; yet while those protective powers press after them to seize them, these falsities still pour out their devastation.

There is also an obscuring state arising from unstable persuasion, which rises into the intermediate region toward that same displayed form of wisdom. Its mark is a vehement impetus of persuasion that drives with bitterness.

Within such violent persuasions the lives held there are purified by being forced out of falsity toward order. Again the governing falsities are stripped of that persuasive covering and descend from it secure in their own character. Wherever they reach the flowing truths of intelligence and the general knowledges of the outer mind, they agitate them into turmoil and raise commotions; they overturn what carries the mind in outward uses and doctrines. They wreak devastation and seize and drag down what they can.

There is also an obscuring state that appears as enlightenment; it too is immediately taken away in the presence of divine wisdom, which shows its mark. Its mark is that it presents itself as tranquil and undisturbing. The lives within it are cleansed through quiet order. Again the governing falsities deprived of that seeming enlightenment come forth; they attempt to appropriate whatever they can, but there protective powers seize them.

Again there is an obscuring state from mixed and confused influx, which also rises toward the displayed form of wisdom. Its mark is that purification occurs within it through quiet and repose; yet the governing falsities stripped of that confusion and coming forth profane and damage whatever they find in the outer life in one way after another, until they are seized and brought into custody.

The coverings they leave behind in the regions they have invaded—whether the works that had proceeded from perverted perception or the derivative formations of corrupted life—are gathered back into the midst of their own domain and wither away. They bring severe spiritual dangers; yet those governing falsities also protective powers send into their midst. The light is drawn out of them, and the hellish forces are cast down into a full series of outermost prisons within the general knowledges that lie outside the ordered mind, which serve as containing forms for falsities beyond the spiritual world.

These prisons and their descents continue until they reach the lowest natural ultimates beneath the final boundary of restraint.

Hear further: at times protective powers are sent to restrain the governing falsities. Whenever the governing falsities are pursued, they plead to avert the restraint, for the protective powers hasten after them by command. Yet those governing falsities are freed only for a time and then take on borrowed external forms of perverted perception and corrupted life. They are sustained and fed by those derived formations. Therefore protective powers set a guard over them, to keep them until the hour when those governing falsities are stripped of those borrowed forms and are brought up again. They are gathered above and poured back into their first states, into the very characters in which they originally were. The remaining light within them is taken away. And they too are cast down into the same full series of outermost ways within the general knowledges outside the ordered mind, to the place where the former ones were cast. They enter into their midst again, and whatever light is in them is removed.

See now: instruction has been given about these obscuring states—how they rise and how the lives within them are purified—and also about the governing falsities within them—how they stir rebellions and how they are caught. They are cast by protective powers into the outer prison when the command comes through the power of manifested divine wisdom, who has authority over the whole intermediate domain and cleanses the life within it.

spiritual_reading.overall_coherence: Strong coherence as a single spiritual account: multiple obscuring states rise into the intermediate domain, purification occurs under manifested divine wisdom, and governing falsities are exposed, restrained, and finally confined after remaining light is removed. The voice is consistent, with minor syntactic breaks where the source text is fragmentary (notably ¶3, ¶6, ¶12, and the “Porter” in ¶15), but the overall process—loosing, manifestation, pursuit, infestation, stripping, guarding, and casting down—reads as one continuous teaching.

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential opening: the teaching begins with a process claim (release → ascent → manifestation) framed by places/regions that function as stages in purification, not as jurisdictions of named officials.
findings.evidence: Text: “released from five places and ascend… revealed and seen in the atmosphere between.” The spiritual reading did not stumble here and could narrate it as one continuous process (“loosened… rise… made manifest within the intermediate region”). The “five places” serves as a process-structure marker, not an inventory of administrators.

findings.diagnosis: Mostly clean correspondential development with minor damage/opacity; no sign of administrative overlay. The only difficulty is syntactic corruption (“exchange in the cloud”) and bracketed gaps, which produced a small interpretive strain but not a narrative break.
findings.evidence: Text: “ascend from fire… towards the likeness of the Virgin of Light… Its sign is the flashes… [and]ts exchange [in the cloud].” The stage-3a notes explicitly: “The clause about ‘exchange in the cloud’ is syntactically unclear.” This is best explained as a damaged line, not a change of teaching-mode: it still works by signs (flash/thunder/wind) and effects (purified/stripped).

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential sequence: pursuit/restraint → infestation of whatever is encountered → functional effects (death, burning, destruction). No governance lists, no jurisdictional catalogues; the story flows directly from stripping to evasion to damage.
findings.evidence: Text: “angels… summoned… seize them… Every place they will touch they shall make dead… assume it… burn and destroy by the fire of their body.” The spiritual reading smoothly tracked this as a single moral-psychological motion (retreat, insinuation, devastation) and only flagged one local oddity (“stripped of the fire”). That oddity is internal paradox (children of fire yet stripped), consistent with Manichaean cosmology (loss of contained light/fire vs retaining fiery nature), not a different voice.

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential shift to a second cloud-type (water) with some fragmentary text; not an insertion. The “rulers… constrained in a water cloud” line is broken but still part of the same functional schema: sign → purification → stripping of rulers → destructive effects → angelic seizure.
findings.evidence: Text: “cloud… raised up from water… Its sign is the thunder storms… there are times… the rulers… are… constrained [in a] water [clou]d. And they flee… abandon it.” The spiritual reading noted: “fragmentary; rendered as confinement,” which is exactly the profile of damaged transmission rather than administrative overlay (no named ranks, no territorial offices).

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential continuations for water-cloud effects (frost/hail) and wind-cloud effects (storm wind; waves; overturn ships). The teaching remains grounded in what each element does, and the narrative remains consistent: the same actors recur (cloud/lives/rulers/angels/Virgin) performing the same roles.
findings.evidence: Text: “make frost and hail and snow… angels… rush after them… cloud… raised up from wind… sign is… storm wind… rivers and seas… waves… overturn the ships.” The spiritual reading did not report a fit-problem here; it could extend the same story-form without forcing new categories or unexplained named entities.

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential ‘light-cloud’ case; the only strain is metaphorical (“sailing in stillness and calm”), which the reader rephrased but did not identify as a narrative break. This is not administrative; it is still sign-and-effect teaching.
findings.evidence: Text: “Its sign is this, in that you shall find it sailing in stillness and calm. The lives in it shall be cleansed…” The reading’s note: “The description of the sign as ‘sailing’ is recast…”—a normal accommodation to imagery, not evidence of a second voice.

findings.diagnosis: Correspondential but locally damaged/opaque: “mingled air” case continues the schema, yet the clause “make it dead one of another” is semantically broken, causing the reader to generalize (“varied modes of profanation”). This is a genuine difficulty, not an insertion.
findings.evidence: Text: “mingled air… Its sign… lives are purified… [Again,] that will be stripped… every place… they shall make it [dead] one of [another]…” The reading explicitly flags it: “The phrase ‘make it dead one of another’ is unclear.” Despite that, the surrounding lines preserve the same process-logic (purification → stripping → harm → seizure).

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential disposal sequence with cosmological imagery; the reader’s slight pressure-point (“waters outside the world”) is an interpretive mapping issue, not a textual seam. The paragraph continues the same functional story: remnants wither; light extracted; demons cast down into containing ‘ditches.’
findings.evidence: Text: “strippings… taken… wither away… They bring the light from them and cast the demons down to these seven outer ditches of the great sea; which is the vessel of the waters that are outside the world.” The reading: “imagery presses… rendered as knowledges outside spiritual order,” i.e., it had to interpret cosmology but did not identify voice-change markers (no jurisdiction lists; the ‘seven’ serves cosmological structure, not administrative ranking).

findings.diagnosis: Genuine difficulty concentrated in a single term (“Porter”) plus bracketed damage; otherwise it is a simple continuation (“descents continue until…”). Not administrative, and removing it would not improve coherence because it supplies the endpoint of the descent logic introduced in ¶13.
findings.evidence: Text: “descents continue… until they reach the earths below… feet of the Porter.” The reading note: “Porter resists precise identification.” This is best explained as a lexeme/title needing contextual identification (possibly a cosmological boundary figure), not as a foreign governance overlay: it does not introduce named ranks or territorial assignments, only a boundary-marker.

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential ‘cycle’ elaboration (temporary embodiment in trees/flesh → guarding → stripping → reversion → further casting down). Although long, it does not switch into an administrative catalogue; the angels’ ‘command’ functions as process-trigger, not as jurisdictional bureaucracy.
findings.evidence: Text: “they are given the command… freed… assume tree and the flesh… angels shall set a guard… until the hour… stripped… gathered… poured out again… cast down to these seven outer paths…” The reader experienced it as an added cycle (“adds a recurrent cycle”), but did not report a narrative break; it remains the same actors and mechanisms. The presence of command/guard language slightly leans administrative, yet it is embedded in functional narrative (what happens to rulers when pursued), so it is best classed as mixed but integral.

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential summary and closure; it restates the chapter’s process (ascent/purification; rulers’ rebellions/capture) and attributes efficacy to the Virgin of Light without introducing new administrative inventories. This is normal recap, not a seam-expansion.
findings.evidence: Text: “I have instructed you… how it shall ascend… lives… purified… rulers… rebellions… caught… cast… when the command is given… Virgin of Light… authority over the entire zone.” The spiritual reading confirms “Strong coherence… voice is consistent,” and this paragraph functions as an inclusio-style summary consistent with the substrate teaching mode.

textual_criticism.summary: No clear insertions or administrative overlay blocks detected. The chapter is dominantly correspondential (process-by-function: five cloud-types, each with sign → purification → stripping → harm → seizure), with three localized genuine difficulties attributable to textual damage/opacity (¶3 ‘exchange’; ¶12 ‘make it dead one of another’; ¶15 ‘Porter’). ¶16 contains mild administrative coloration (‘command’, ‘guard’) but remains integrated into the functional narrative; no excision or annotation is recommended.

harmonized_paragraphs.text: Happen you know that it shall be released from five places and ascend over this great earth and [in the sea and in the rivers] and it is revealed and seen in the atmosphere between.

So, the cloud shall ascend from fire to the heavens towards the likeness of the Virgin of Light that she shall display to it. Its sign is the flashes that occur with lightning storms [and]ts exchange [in the cloud]. And they shall be purified by her towards [the place of the Virgin of Light] the light that she shall reveal [to it]. The rulers shall be released by the lightning storms and they are freed and sent.

However, [these] angels shall immediately be summoned to them, so that they will seize them, because they know that they shall never do good. Every place they will touch they shall make dead and a loss. Whenever the angels will make towards them and come beside [them], they shall flee in their constraint before them. They go into whatever they will meet upon and assume it, like a robber being abandoned and fleeing before one stronger than him, as he runs after him to arrest him.

Now, those rulers that shall be freed from these clouds and assume whatever they will meet upon [and enter] into the [trees] that they did not [find the way,] will seize this thing, whether indeed a tree to which they have found the way, or animals, or people. Simply, every place that they will assume they shall burn and destroy by the fire of their body. Namely, the rulers, [the] children of fire, they that shall be stripped of the fire.

In contrast, [the] cloud that shall be raised up from water, and comes above towards the Virgin of Light; its sign is the thunder storms and the booms that shall come in the atmosphere in various forms and are heard. [And] Again, there are times if the rulers that belong to them, which exist in the cloud, shall on occasion be constrained [in a] water [clou]d. And they flee from it and abandon it.

Now, [they] too are so, in that every place that they will [reach], they shall make frost and hail and snow. [They rui]n the seed-corn and the fruits and the plants; and they [waste] every place [that] they will reach.
Again, [ang]els shall be summoned to them who seize them. Still, while the angels [ru]sh after them in order to seize them, they shall make this destruction.

Also, [the cl]oud that will be raised up from wind ascends to the atmosphere between, towards the likeness of the Virgin that she shall display to it. Its sign is [the s]torm wind that shall blow with bitterness.

So, in those winds and tempests shall the lives be purified. Again, the rulers will be stripped of the cloud of wind and they descend from it, safe in their image. All the rivers and the seas that they will reach and arrive at, they shall make waves in them and raise [billows] and they [overturn] the ships. They wreak destruction [in the seas] and they seize and bring them [downwards].

Also the cloud, the one of light, immediately they will be stripped of it [before] the Virgin. She shall display its sign too [as well]. And its sign is this, in that you shall find it sailing in stillness and calm. The lives in it shall be cleansed in stillness and calm. Again, the rulers that will be stripped of it [in the atmosphere] that will come forth [are those] they shall put [from it,] and they take [upon] there [whatever they will meet upon;] the angels seize them.

Again, the cloud that shall be raised up from the mingled air comes above towards [the image] of the Virgin. Its sign is this, in that [the lives] are purified in it in stillness and [repose. Again,] that will be stripped of that cloud and come from it; every place that they will find [upon it,] they shall make it [dead] one of [another] until [the angels come upon them] they are seized and taken to their midst.

Their strippings, that they shall leave behind them in various places they will have reached, whether the produce of the trees or the offspring of the fleshes, they shall be taken midst [their place, and they] wither away. They shall inflict great dangers, but again those rulers also the angels shall send to their midst. They bring the light from them and cast the demons down to these seven outer ditches of the great sea; which is the vessel of the waters that are outside the world.
Those ditches and the [descents continue] until they reach the earths below [the] feet of the Porter.

Hear also [again,] for sometimes these angels shall be sent to them, to seize the rulers. Whenever the rulers [flee] for the angels rush after them. They beseech them [to let them go,] they that are given the command. However, [t]hose [rul]ers shall be freed from them alone and assume [tree] and [the fle]sh. They are consumed by this offspring [of] tree and that of flesh. The angels shall set a [guard] over them, that they might guard them until the hour when [those r]ulers will be stripped of tree and [flesh; a]nd they go up above. They shall be gathered [together] above, and they are poured out [again] in their first for[ms and their first im]ages in which they first were. They take the light from them, which had remained behind in them. And they too are cast down to these seven outer [path]s that are in the great sea; the place to where these former ones [were c as]t. They shall reach their midst [again,] and the light that is in them is taken.

Behold now, I have instructed you about this cloud: How it shall ascend above, and the lives that are in it are purified. I have also taught you of the rulers that are in it: how they shall make these {rebellions} and how they shall be {caught}. And they are cast to the outer prison by the angels, when the command is given to them through the power of the Virgin of Light. She has authority over the entire zone, and cleanses the life that is in it.

changes_summary: No changes made. The critic’s findings (1–11) recommended ‘none’ throughout, with only localized damage/opacity noted (¶3, ¶12, ¶15) and mild administrative coloration in ¶16 judged integral; therefore no excisions were warranted.
